question: If B is the daughter of A, and C is the brother of A, how is C related to B?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

 
• B is the daughter of A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5584a72714482b4ac4bd728fe2fb4ee2b4636796471dedae6f68db31d69b2572.png]
